plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SaMi Runner uses your location while you are online and while completing errands so SaMi can match suitable requests and share progress with customers.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SaMi Runner uses your location while you are online or completing an accepted errand, including when the app is in the background. This allows SaMi to maintain its dispatch availability and share live progress with customers. Tracking stops when you go offline or finish your errand.

plugins.cameraPermission: SaMi Runner uses the camera to capture errand evidence and support optional in-app video calls.
plugins.microphonePermission: SaMi Runner uses the microphone when you choose to use in-app voice or video calling.

plugins.photosPermission: SaMi Runner accesses selected photos when you attach errand evidence or documents.
